input.escena: from the traveler's own eyes, both hands slip a small bottle into a clear resealable plastic bag, held up in the upper half of the frame above the table; around it a small perfume bottle, a tube of cream and a travel shampoo without labels, and beside it an open carry-on suitcase with folded clothes. It reads as packing the liquids bag before a trip, not as a product still life
input.hora: afternoon the day before the trip
input.clima: indoors, abundant natural window light, open shadows, natural colour

input.prohibir: readable text or logos on bottles, tubes or suitcase, recognisable perfume brands, invented millilitre figures on labels, industrial aerosols, cleaning products
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the hands and the clear bag sit only between 15% and 46% of the frame height, centred between 30% and 70% of the width; nothing touches the top edge, with wall or window visible above the hands. The lower half is the calm table top and the out-of-focus suitcase edge, mid-dark. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 50 mm equivalent, close lived detail of hands and objects, intimate without isolating them from the place.
